svg.title: Microsoft Foundry and Two of Its Tools
svg.desc: Three capabilities: Microsoft Foundry as the platform for models, agents, evaluation, deployment and monitoring; Azure Vision for image analysis and OCR; and Azure AI Search for keyword, vector and semantic retrieval.
svg.text: Microsoft Foundry and Two of Its Tools
The platform builds and runs the app; the tools do specialised jobs inside it.
Model catalog, agents, evaluations, content safety, deployment, monitoring
